verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs explicitly describe network volumes as persistent storage that exists independently of compute and is retained on termination or scale-to-zero, shareable across machines/products, plus an S3-compatible API to manage files without launching a Pod. This directly matches the story of datasets/checkpoints outliving GPU rentals. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of durability across teardown and details on volume size/performance limits or region constraints.
